name: Turborg borg
notes: New terminal-first coding agent. Current upstream documents a single static Go binary, local Ollama/llama.cpp/LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible backends, hosted xShellz models, permission-gated tools, sessions, and self-verification loops. The installer creates the turborg binary and a borg alias when available.

name: QUANT CLI
notes: New PyPI-installable local terminal coding agent with LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, and DeepSeek providers; file, shell, git, web, memory, and process tools; multiple modes; plugin support; and command-safety backups.

name: Quantex CLI
notes: New lifecycle CLI for terminal coding assistants. Current upstream documents install/inspect/update/uninstall/run flows across Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, Kilo, and others, with qtx/quantex binaries, JSON/NDJSON output, dry-run, and managed provider-aware installs.

name: QodeX
notes: New local-first terminal coding agent with Qwen/Ollama/LM Studio defaults, deterministic syntax/completion/verification gates, 100+ tools, browser automation, MCP, memory, sub-agent orchestration, dashboards, and optional Telegram/Discord/Slack control. Installer builds and links qodex plus qx.
